rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Narrow steep lane between houses with no room to pull off.
reasons: No room clear of narrow lane

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 10 m and 15 m away, homes within 25 m all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Tight lane, tree cover and house frontages either side; nowhere to pull fully off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet lane but meets Swann Road at the top.
drivers.convention: No Stopping signs nearby, including any time on Swann Road and weekdays on Darvall Street.

flags: No Stopping Any Time (Swann Road) and Mon-Fri signs

best_section.where: Upper end of the narrow lane before Swann Road junction
